case_name: Mataprasad v State of Uttar Pradesh
respondent:
State of Uttar Pradesh
Supreme Court of India

8 February 1994
The Judgment was delivered by RAY, J.- This appeal is directed against the judgment dated October 22, 1982 passed by the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court in Criminal Appeal Nos. 544 of 1976 and 545 of 1976 modifying the conviction and sentence passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Gonda in Sessions Trial No. 222 of 1974. Nine accused persons including the six appellants in this appeal faced trial in the said sessions case on charges under Sections 120-B, 148, 302 read with Section s 149 and 147 IPC for murdering one Radhey Shyam on April 23, 1974. The learned Sessions Judge convicted accused 1, 5 and 6 namely, Amrika, Nauranglal and Raja Ram under Sections 120-B, 148, 302 read with S. 149 IPC and sentenced them to suffer two years' rigorous imprisonment u/s. 148 and the imprisonment for life u/s. 302 read with S. 149 IPC. No separate sentence was, however, awarded under Section 120-B IPC. Th
facts: Nine accused persons including the six appellants in this appeal faced trial in the said sessions case on charges under Sections 120-B, 148, 302 read with Section s 149 and 147 IPC for murdering one Radhey Shyam on April 23, 1974.

The learned Sessions Judge convicted accused 1, 5 and 6 namely, Amrika, Nauranglal and Raja Ram under Sections 120-B, 148, 302 read with S. 149 IPC and sentenced them to suffer two years' rigorous imprisonment u/s. 148 and the imprisonment for life u/s. 302 read with S. 149 IPC.

Accused 3 Mata Prasad, accused 4 Bachcha Lai and accused 2 Ambar, under Sections 147, 302 read with S. 149 IPC and awarded sentence of one year's rigorous imprisonment for the offence u/s. 147 and life imprisonment u/s. 302 read with S. 149 IPC.

Accused 7 Kapil Deo, was also convicted under Sections 147, 120-B and 302 read with S. 149 IPC and one year's rigorous imprisonment was awarded for the offence u/s. 147 and imprisonment for life for the offence u/s. 302 read with S. 149 IPC.
The said accused persons preferred two appeals before the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court being Criminal Appeal Nos. 544 of 1976 and 545 of 1976.
petitioner_arguments: Each of the accused persons gave their respective version in support of the contention that Radhey Shyam, his father, Baijnath, PW 2 and the said eyewitness Muni Ram were inimical to the accused persons for different reasons.
It was also contended on behalf of the accused persons that Radhey Shyam was a man of desperate character and was challenged on the charge of dacoity on a few occasions.
court_reasoning: The conviction under Section 120-B IPC was set aside in favour of all the appellants.

In both the said appeals the conviction and sentence passed by the learned Sessions Judge against Mata Prasad, Naurang Lai, Amrika and Raja Ram under Sections 148, 302 read with S. 149 IPC were upheld by the High Court.
holding: The instant appeal has been preferred by accused 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7, namely, Amrika, Amber, Mata Prasad, Naurang Lai, Ra ja Ram and Kapil Deo.
